'''Geober''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he challenged another [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] to a multi-system race with their [[Starship/Legends|starships]] as the prize.<ref name="Star Wars Gamemaster Screen">''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Screen]]''</ref>
